newsitem.title: USA: Employers Re declines comment on new venture.
newsitem.headline: Employers Re declines comment on new venture.

text.p: Employers Reinsurance Corp declined comment on a report that it was forming a finite and financial reinsurance company with Bermuda company Cat Ltd.

The Rendezvous Reporter newsletter said that at a reinsurance conference in Monte Carlo last week, Employers Re officials told it that the new U.S.-based company will be called Enterprise Re and was expected to be launched within a few days.
Employers Re, a unit of General Electric Co's GE Capital, was to own 30 percent, with the rest divided among Cat Ltd and its present shareholders.

Cat Ltd told Reuters, "One additional piece of information which did not appear in this (Rendezvous Reporter) article is that the president and chief underwriting officer of the company will be Jon Roberts who joins Enterprise from AIG (American International Group Inc) where he was responsible for finite and financial reinsurance."
Cat Ltd's investors include Morgan Stanley Partners Fund, Zurich Insurance Group, General Motors Pension Fund, AT&T Pension Fund, Chase Capital Partners and Chubb Corp.

Employers Re senior vice president Hoyt Wood told the newsletter he expects Enterprise Re to be ready for 1997 business. He also said the two companies are in the early stages of negotiations to form a similar partnership in Europe.
Employers Re chief executive Kaj Ahlmann told the newsletter the deal gives Employers the opportunity to combine its distribution network with experts in the business from Cat Ltd.
